episodes.title: Chance Encounters
episodes.summary: A spilled drink at a bar leads to an awkward day at work for Louise, who's shaken again by night terrors. David introduces Adele to his new colleagues.

episodes.title: Lucid Dreaming
episodes.summary: A peek inside David and Adele's private life — and a look at Rob's dream journal — leaves Louise with more questions than answers.

episodes.title: The First Door
episodes.summary: Against her better judgment, Louise grows attached to both David and Adele, becoming increasingly enmeshed in their tense, complicated marriage.

episodes.title: Rob
episodes.summary: An accusation of violence threatens to unravel David's life, and more shocking news awaits him and Louise when Adele drops a bombshell.

episodes.title: The Second Door
episodes.summary: Despite David's warnings, Louise can't shake her concern for Adele, who sows seeds of doubt over what happened with Rob on her family estate.

episodes.title: Behind Her Eyes
episodes.summary: A stunning revelation makes Louise dig deeper into David and Adele's past, and what she discovers pushes her to demand the truth.
